messages:
Mariam Okoye: Quick update — temporary coverage plan for the next 6 weeks.

Mariam Okoye: Tomas is moving to the Platform Infra project full-time for an 8-week deep-dive starting Mon (cross-org priority). To avoid gaps on Observability and Capacity we’re doing two interim assignments:
- Priya Natarajan will be Interim Observability Lead (primary) — she'll keep owning dashboards/alerts and weekly oncall handoffs.
- Raj Patel will be Interim Capacity Lead (primary) — will run capacity planning, reserved pools, and infra forecasts.
Both reports remain dotted to their original managers; this is temporary/limited to 6 weeks.

Mariam Okoye: We’re also opening a 30-day backfill for a Senior Platform Product Ops (IC3) to take over the product liaison duties. Hiring panel planned next Thu.

Priya Natarajan: ack — I’ll post a short runbook this afternoon and take the oncall handover Tues 9am.

Raj Patel: happy to take it. Can someone confirm if the capacity playbook has the new burst policy details? @Jordan Kim?

Jordan Kim: yes — updated w/ burst policy last sprint. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/capacity/playbook

Mariam Okoye: thanks @Jordan. Quick rota (will update in Google Calendar):
```
Week1: Priya (obs lead), Raj (cap lead)
Week2: Priya, Raj
Week3: Priya, Raj
Week4: Priya, Raj
Week5: handback week — Tomas shadowing
Week6: wrap + recruitment overlap
```

Nora Elbaz: any impact on Dedicated customer SLAs while Tomas is on Infra? We should flag critical customers.

Mariam Okoye: Good call — CS will be notified today. @Diego Morales is leading customer comms and will post the status update in #customer-success by EOD.

Diego Morales: will do. Drafting message now, will cc product and eng. :memo:

hiring-bot: New role posted — Senior Platform Product Ops (IC3). Req ID 5542. Applications open until 30 days from today.

Evan Carter: are we doing a formal interim comp adjustment for Priya/Raj? HR to confirm.

Mariam Okoye: HR is checking; if eligible, we'll apply interim shadow premiums. I'll update by EOD tomorrow.

Priya Natarajan: thanks all. I’ll start the runbook and link it here when ready. :thumbsup: 

Mariam Okoye: appreciate it — will follow up with a calendar invite for the handoff and post the candidate rubric for the hiring panel. :tada:
